html:
Looking for local window tinting Sydney based services? Look no further! Tint a Home offers both residential window tinting in Sydney and commercial window tinting in Sydney. We are Australia’s most trusted window tinting network and specialise in window tinting in Sydney. Below is a list of the films available in our range for commercial and residential window tinting in Sydney along with details on how to contact us for window tinting Sydney prices.

We have been providing tinting services in Australia for over 42 years and our films are government certified by ARPANSA to ensure the highest quality. For peace of mind, we offer a lifetime warranty for residential applications & up to 15 years for commercial applications. Here are the films available in our range for residential and commercial window tinting Sydney:

Films For Commercial And Residential Window Tinting Sydney

Films in our range for residential and commercial window tinting Sydney include:

  1. Solar Films: Our solar films reduce heat and glare entering your home or office. They are ideal for commercial window tinting in Sydney as the reduction in glare helps to reduce reflections on computer screens. Our solar films keep your home or office cooler in the summer months and warmer in the winter months making a positive difference to your power bills. They also help to protect people, flooring and furnishing from the damage caused by harmful UV rays.
  2. Security Films: Our security film is up to 10 times thicker and 7 x stronger than standard film. When hit with force, it will help keep shattered glass in place so slows access into your home or office in the event of a break-in and also keeps people safe from injuries if the glass is broken. Our security film is ideal for both commercial and home window tinting in Sydney as it helps to keep people and valuables safe & secure.
  3. Safety Films: Safety film is designed to keep you and your family safe giving you peace of mind. It is stronger than standard film and if the glass is broken it doesn’t shatter as it holds the broken glass together. It also helps to prevent break-ins as it makes it harder to enter your home.
  4. Decorative Films: Our decorative films are suitable for both homes and offices but are ideal for commercial window tinting in Sydney as you can customise designs with your branding. They are great for creating a divider and can add a stylish touch to your home or office.

For privacy, you can choose a reflective film that turns your windows into a mirror, so those on the outside can’t see in or if privacy isn’t an issue, we have lighter shades of film that offer the benefits of tinting but don’t alter the appearance of your home.

Contact Us Today for A Quote

Use our Store Finder to find your local tinting Sydney based team and speak to us today about residential window tinting Sydney, commercial window tinting Sydney and window tinting Sydney prices. You can also call our customer service team on 13 TINT.
